approach: Add a thin I/O layer to scope_guard.rs: build RequestRecords from Records (attempt = closed request job; unmet criterion = first met==false verification criterion; cost = spent_usd(); minutes = sum of invocation wall_time; plan size and round from latest JobPlan; retry_of via retried_job; quotes = known job ids in request text), group with group_lines, call evaluate_before_attempt. Persist per-line flags and any pause record {signal, numbers, lift, at} as a JSON file under the state dir (pattern of disk::write_hold). Athena::go runs the watcher after a job finishes (never touches processes). dispatch in run.rs and Athena::retry refuse a paused line with the pause reason. status() gains a scope_guard list; display.rs prints it.

decisions.choice: Store flags and pause records as JSON files in the state directory, read and written by scope_guard.rs.
decisions.reason: No athena-data record type is on the deliverable list; a new type needs schema, validators and docs. The disk hold already uses this pattern.

rejected.option: New athena.scope-pause record in athena-data and records/
rejected.why: Touches the schema crate and docs outside the deliverables; too large for one run.

rejected.option: Derive the pause on every check with no stored record
rejected.why: Criterion 1 needs an existing pause record, and later threshold changes would silently lift old pauses.

decisions.choice: The pause record names the strongest signal (Pause beats Flag; ties to lowest number) and lists the numbers of every signal at Pause.
decisions.reason: One clear reason per refusal; status shows every tripped signal.

rejected.why: More files, harder message, no extra information.

decisions.choice: Lift text: T4 asks for a measurement of the target or a narrowed request (a new ask, which is a new line); T3 and T5 a measurement of remaining cost or time; T2 a smaller plan. No resume command.
decisions.reason: Matches section 5; a lift command is not requested.

decisions.choice: Evaluate in the Finished arm of go, and check at the top of dispatch and in retry.
decisions.reason: The Finished arm already hosts non-blocking follow-ups; errors are logged, not returned. Nothing touches the registry kill path, so running jobs are never stopped.

rejected.why: It holds the job lock and commits records; a watcher failure could affect the job outcome.

decisions.choice: Keep the one-call change in reading.rs (Athena::retry is defined at reading.rs:699, not in run.rs), which answers finding 2 by showing no listed file holds retry. Add the refusal as a call to scope_guard::refuse_if_paused so the logic stays in scope_guard.rs.
decisions.reason: Criterion 3 requires retry itself to refuse. The change is one call before ask; the alternative of refusing only at dispatch would let retry record a new request.

rejected.why: retry would still commit a 'try again on' request, failing criterion 3.

decisions.choice: T3 forecast p90 passes 0.0 unless an existing per-class source is readable.
decisions.reason: t3_cost documents 0 as not used; no new estimator in a rules-only job.

files.purpose: Watcher: build line records, evaluate, write/read flag and pause files, refuse_if_paused, pause text, tests.
Call the watcher after a job finishes in go; call the pause check at the top of dispatch.
One call to refuse_if_paused in Athena::retry before ask (retry is defined here, not in a listed file).
Add scope_guard list to StatusView and fill it from stored flags and pauses.
Print flagged and paused lines with signal, numbers and lift.
Unreleased entry for the running-line watcher.
Section 13: mark job 5 built; record where pauses live and how they lift.

steps: Read Records accessors: JobRecords::state, verification criteria, spent_usd, invocation wall_time, plans, and retried_job in reading.rs.
In scope_guard.rs add request_records(records), line lookup, and LineState with serde.
Add PauseRecord {signal, numbers, lift, at} and text builders for T1–T5.
Add watch_after_attempt(state, records, job_id) writing <root>/scope-guard/<line-head>.json; no process or registry calls.
Add refuse_if_paused returning an error with signal, numbers and lift.
Call the watcher in go after Finished (errors logged only); call refuse_if_paused at the top of dispatch and in Athena::retry before ask.
Add LineSignalView and scope_guard to StatusView; fill in status().
Update CHANGELOG.md and docs/design/scope-guard.md; run fmt, clippy, test.

risks.mitigation: Match only full job ids that exist in Records; test with an unrelated id.

risks.risk: A stale pause file blocks work with no lift.
risks.mitigation: Refusal names the lift; a narrowed request starts a new line; closing the paused job drops its pause file.

risks.risk: Watcher I/O failure breaks go or hides the result.
risks.mitigation: Run after the result is computed; log errors via ui, never return them.
Key the file by the line's first job id and overwrite it.
Reuse existing constants; pause text states the numbers.

demonstrations.method: Test in scope_guard.rs with hand-built Records and a temp state dir: two rejected jobs on one line with the same unmet criterion (digits differing); run the watcher, then the dispatch check for a third 'try again on' attempt.
demonstrations.observes: A pause file exists under the state dir; the third dispatch returns an error with the pause reason; no new invocation recorded.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the watcher write or the dispatch check, the third attempt proceeds and the file and refusal assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: Same harness, two rejections with differing unmet criteria.
demonstrations.observes: A T1 flag is recorded, no pause file exists, and the dispatch check allows the next attempt.
demonstrations.fails_without: If every flag were treated as a pause the dispatch check would refuse; if flags were not recorded the flag assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Test calls Athena::retry on a job in a paused line and on an unpaused rejected job.
demonstrations.observes: The paused call returns Err containing the signal, numbers and lift text and commits no new record; the unpaused call succeeds.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the check in retry, 'try again on <job>' is asked and committed, failing the refusal and record-count assertions.

demonstrations.method: Test builds status with one flagged (T1) and one paused (T4) line and asserts both the StatusView data and the rendered display text.
demonstrations.observes: The rendered text contains T1, flag, T4, pause and the line's job id; with no signals nothing extra is printed.
demonstrations.fails_without: If status did not read the stored flags or display did not print them, the signal lines would be missing.

demonstrations.method: Test reads written pause records for a T4 pause and a T3 pause and checks fields.
demonstrations.observes: Signal, numbers (rejection count and criterion texts for T4; spend and p90 for T3) and lift text (mentions narrowed request for T4, measurement otherwise) are non-empty and match the inputs.
demonstrations.fails_without: An empty or generic record fails the field assertions.

demonstrations.method: Test registers a running job on the line, runs the watcher to a Pause, and asserts the job is still running; CHANGELOG.md diff checked for the watcher entry.
demonstrations.observes: The registry still shows the job running and no signal is sent; git diff shows an Unreleased CHANGELOG entry naming the running-line watcher.
demonstrations.fails_without: A kill in the pause path would change the running job's state and fail the assertion.

demonstrations.method: Run the lint and format checks Athena runs over the whole change including the new tests.
demonstrations.observes: Clippy exits zero with no warnings; cargo fmt --all --check also exits zero.
demonstrations.fails_without: Any unformatted code, unused item or clippy lint in the new watcher, status or display code makes clippy or fmt exit non-zero, failing the criterion.

open_questions: reading.rs is not in the brief's deliverables but holds Athena::retry; a one-call edit there is needed for criterion 3. Confirm acceptable.
Whether a measurement alone can lift a T4 pause without a new command is unsettled; the plan lifts only by a new unlinked narrowed request.
Where a per-kind forecast p90 can be read from existing records was not checked; fallback is 0.0.
An end-to-end go test would live in crates/athena-cli/tests/lifecycle.rs (not listed); minimum tests sit in scope_guard.rs.
Unit handling of invocation wall_time for agent minutes was not checked.
